resources.string: This space is an unofficial client for Stremio add-ons. Add-ons are small web services made by independent developers. Telos only shows what an add-on offers and plays it: it includes no add-ons, hosts no videos and does not check what an add-on provides. You are responsible for what you add and watch, and for having the right to watch it where you live. Some add-ons use BitTorrent, which shows your IP address to other users. Telos is not affiliated with Stremio.
There are no add-ons yet. Add one to see its catalogs and streams. Telos does not include any.

Sign in with your Stremio account to keep your add-ons, library and continue watching in step with it. Your password is sent only to Stremio (api.strem.io) and is not stored. This uses Stremio\'s account service, which Stremio can change or block at any time. Telos is not affiliated with Stremio.
Add-ons listed by your installed add-ons and by Stremio\'s public list. They are made by others and are not checked by Telos or Stremio.
